inputs.usable_for: gobbajogger/DnBOX firmware builds on Linux x86_64

inputs.contains_source_for: gobbajogger/X0X37-for-Loopy-Pro at historical 7537a46ab49419920428299db8f3321d01e6fd16 only; not DnBOX source
inputs.usable_for: historical fetch/integrity-script patterns; do not substitute for either source repo

inputs.note: Older V1.2.1 SDK in bootstrap does not satisfy current firmware pin; actual V1.2.14 archive must be retrieved and checked.

instructions: Do not treat the older X0X37 bootstrap snapshot as DnBOX source.
On a network-connected runner fetch each git commit directly using the source_git_url and check git rev-parse HEAD against source_repositories[*].commit and HEAD^{tree} against tree.
Unpack the toolchain ZIP and verify SHA-256; set JIELI_TOOLCHAIN to the directory with pi32v2 and common.
Fetch the pinned SDK V1.2.14 and verify the three hashes from tools/build.py before firmware builds.
Do not flash devices or publish firmware.
